dict.string: SHOS lets the agent read your calendar when you turn the Calendar capability on.
SHOS lets the agent read your calendar when you turn the Calendar capability on.
SHOS looks up contacts by name when you ask the agent about someone, and only after you switch Contacts on in SHOS ▸ Capabilities.
SHOS can read your Health data — steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts — only after you switch Apple Health on in SHOS ▸ Capabilities, and only to answer what you ask the agent.
SHOS never writes to Apple Health. It only reads, and only after you switch Apple Health on in SHOS ▸ Capabilities. This description is required because the app links HealthKit.
SHOS uses a local connection only when its optional Linux workspace is needed.

SHOS uses your location only while you are using the app, when the agent needs it for something you asked and after you switch Location on in SHOS ▸ Capabilities. SHOS does not track your location in the background.
SHOS asks for your location only when the agent needs it for something you asked, and only after you switch Location on in SHOS ▸ Capabilities. It never tracks you in the background.
SHOS lets the agent read your reminders when you turn the Reminders capability on.
SHOS lets the agent read your reminders when you turn the Reminders capability on.
